description: KN-F10L24AC is the drawing identifier for fuse terminal component in AutomationDirect's Konnect-It DIN-Rail Terminal Blocks collection. A fuse terminal combines a wiring interface with a selected fuse-system function. Fuse selection and the compatible terminal accessories are separate electrical and product decisions.

For example, in a control-power marshalling strip with individually protected circuits, use the KN-F10L24AC reference to coordinate fuse access, conductor approach and terminal identification. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-F10L24AC.dwg, Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-F10L24DC.dwg, Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-F10L110AC.DWG, Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-F10L110DC.dwg, Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-F10L220AC.dwg, Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-F10L220DC.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
